news.title: Confirmed Chelsea Women line up vs Real Sociedad
news.title_zh: 确认切尔西女足对阵皇家社会队的阵容
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor has named her first starting XI of the 2026/27 campaign, with the Blues facing Real Sociedad in the Women's Champions League third qualifying round first leg at Plough Lane. Our third-place finish in the Women's Super League last term means we will play this qualifier against the Spanish side to determine whether or not we enter the league phase of this season's Women's Champions League. The match will be played over two legs, with the second fixture at the Estadio Zubieta in San Sebastian scheduled for 2 September at 6pm. Blues head coach Sonia Bompastor has named defender Naomi Girma as her skipper for the evening, while summer signing Katie McCabe comes straight into the starting XI. Fellow arrivals Giulia Dragoni, Nelly Las and Melvine Malard all make the substitutes' bench, and Manaka Matsukubo misses out through injury as Bompastor confirmed in her pre-match press conference. Chelsea: Hampton, Carpenter, Girma (c), Buurman, McCabe, Walsh, Nusken, Thompson, James, Baltimore, Beever-Jones Chelsea substitutes: Peng, Spencer, Bjorn, Bronze, Dragoni, Hamano, Potter, Las, Kaptein, Malard, Sarwie
news.body_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯托已经任命了她2026/27赛季的首个首发阵容，蓝军将在女足冠军联赛第三轮资格赛首回合的普洛巷迎战皇家社会。我们上赛季在女超联赛中获得第三名，这意味着我们将在本次预选赛中对阵西班牙球队，以确定我们是否进入本赛季女足冠军联赛的联赛阶段。比赛将进行两回合比赛，第二场比赛定于 9 月 2 日下午 6 点在圣塞巴斯蒂安的祖别塔体育场举行。蓝军主教练索尼娅·邦帕斯托任命后卫纳奥米·吉尔玛为今晚的队长，而夏季签约的凯蒂·麦凯布则直接进入首发阵容。新加盟的朱莉娅·德拉戈尼、内莉·拉斯和梅尔文·马拉德都进入了替补席，邦帕斯特在赛前新闻发布会上证实，松久保真中因伤缺席。切尔西：汉普顿、卡彭特、吉尔马（中）、布尔曼、麦凯布、沃尔什、努斯肯、汤普森、詹姆斯、巴尔的摩、比弗-琼斯 切尔西替补：彭、斯宾塞、比约恩、布隆泽、德拉戈尼、哈野、波特、拉斯、卡普坦、马拉德、萨维

news.title: Alonso on a balancing act and team focus
news.title_zh: 阿隆索谈平衡行为和团队焦点
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso explained why it will be vital for him to find the right balance to his team to face Luton Town on Thursday evening. Chelsea’s Carabao Cup campaign kicks off in west London tomorrow night, when we host League One side Luton in Alonso’s first competitive match on home soil in the Stamford Bridge dugout. Ahead of the second round tie, our Spanish manager was asked if he is likely to rotate his starting XI for this knockout game. It comes hot on the heels of Monday’s 3-2 win at Fulham in our opening Premier League fixture of the season, with the league visit of Brighton & Hove Albion fast approaching on Sunday. Alonso insisted he won’t be taking our Carabao Cup opponents lightly, ensuring that any rotation retains the right balance and competitiveness in the Chelsea line-up, as he plots our progress across three domestic fronts this season. ‘This season, knowing that we have time for all the competitions, every cup is important, every game is important,’ insisted Xabi. ‘We want to have the best competitive team to face Luton, with all the respect that everything deserves. And Luton are going to be the first game in the Carabao Cup. ‘The main thing is the quality of the players, that they adjust and that we have balance with the players around them that makes sense and makes the team better. ‘That is always my main focus, that the team is better with the qualities and knowing the best qualities of each individual player.’ During his pre-match press conference ahead of the Carabao Cup second round meeting with Luton, Alonso was also asked if he offered any specific words for Robert Sanchez in the last couple of days. It is clear that it is the team’s performance which is foremost in the mind of manager and players. ‘No, normal conversations,’ our manager responded. ‘We have talked more about team things, what we did well, what we have to do better. It was more about understanding the context of the game. ‘Every game is going to be important because we are in this process where we need to develop things, we need to make adjustments and we are more team focused.’
news.body_zh: 哈比·阿隆索解释了为什么在周四晚上对阵卢顿镇时为球队找到适当的平衡对他来说至关重要。切尔西的卡拉宝杯比赛将于明天晚上在伦敦西部拉开帷幕，届时我们将在斯坦福桥教练席迎战联赛球队卢顿，这是阿隆索在主场的第一场正式比赛。在第二轮比赛之前，我们的西班牙主帅被问及是否有可能在这场淘汰赛中轮换首发阵容。周一我们在本赛季首场英超比赛中以 3-2 战胜富勒姆，紧接着周日布莱顿的联赛访问也即将到来。阿隆索坚称，他不会轻视我们的卡拉宝杯对手，确保任何轮换都能在切尔西阵容中保持适当的平衡和竞争力，同时他还规划了我们本赛季在三个国内战线上的进步。 “这个赛季，我们有时间参加所有比赛，每场杯赛都很重要，每场比赛都很重要，”哈维坚持说。 “我们希望拥有一支最具竞争力的球队来面对卢顿，并得到一切应有的尊重。卢顿将是卡拉宝杯的第一场比赛。 “最重要的是球员的素质，他们会进行调整，我们与他们周围的球员保持平衡，这有意义并使球队变得更好。 “这始终是我的主要关注点，球队的素质更好，并且了解每个球员的最佳素质。”在卡拉宝杯第二轮对阵卢顿的赛前新闻发布会上，阿隆索还被问到他在过去几天是否对罗伯特·桑切斯提出了任何具体的说法。显然，教练和球员最关心的是球队的表现。 “不，正常的对话，”我们的经理回答道。 “我们更多地谈论了团队的事情，我们做得好的地方，我们必须做得更好的地方。更多的是关于理解游戏的背景。 “每场比赛都将很重要，因为我们正处于这个过程中，我们需要开发东西，我们需要做出调整，我们更加注重团队。”

news.title: Xabi Alonso delivers the latest Chelsea team news ahead of Luton
news.title_zh: 哈比·阿隆索在卢顿之前发布了最新的切尔西队新闻
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso confirmed at his pre-match press conference that both Moises Caicedo and Marco Palestra will miss Thursday’s Carabao Cup clash with Luton Town. The duo were both absent against Fulham on opening day, a game that the Blues won 3-2, and Alonso has announced that they will again sit out on Thursday - but Caicedo could return for the weekend visit of his former side Brighton. Elsewhere, the Spaniard stated that goalkeeper Mike Penders has an opportunity to feature, while he also expects Enzo Fernandez to be in the squad. ‘Not for tomorrow, both won’t make it [against Luton],’ Alonso said of Caicedo and Palestra. ‘Let’s see, hopefully Moi could make it for the weekend, but we need to check a little bit more with Marco. ‘Otherwise everyone from Monday is okay, Cole [Palmer] is absolutely fine. ‘Penders is part of the squad, so he has an opportunity. We will decide and then I am giving the team tomorrow to the players, so I prefer to respect that they know first. ‘Enzo, yes we expect him to be involved. He is training really well, he’s a good professional, and he will be involved.’
news.body_zh: 哈比·阿隆索在赛前新闻发布会上证实，莫伊塞斯·凯塞多和马科·帕莱斯特拉都将缺席周四与卢顿镇的联赛杯比赛。两人都缺席了揭幕战对阵富勒姆的比赛，这场比赛蓝军以 3-2 获胜，阿隆索宣布他们将在周四再次缺席，但凯塞多可能会在周末对阵他的前东家布莱顿的比赛中回归。在其他地方，西班牙人表示门将迈克·彭德斯有机会出场，同时他也希望恩佐·费尔南德斯能够加入球队。 “明天不行，两人都不会（对阵卢顿），”阿隆索谈到凯塞多和帕莱斯特拉时说道。 “让我们看看，希望莫伊能够度过周末，但我们需要与马可进行更多检查。 “除此之外，从周一开始大家都还好，科尔（帕尔默）绝对没问题。 “彭德斯是球队的一员，所以他有机会。我们将做出决定，然后我将明天的球队交给球员，所以我更愿意尊重他们首先知道的事情。 “恩佐，是的，我们希望他参与其中。他训练得非常好，他是一名优秀的职业球员，他会参与其中。”

news.title: Chelsea vs Luton: Key statistics and facts
news.title_zh: 切尔西 vs 卢顿：关键统计数据和事实
news.body_en: Chelsea begin our Carabao Cup campaign at the second-round stage, with a tie against League One Luton Town. Here are all the facts and figures you need ahead of the Hatters' visit to Stamford Bridge. Chelsea meet Luton Town for the first time since December 2023. Chelsea and Luton have never met in the League Cup before. We have faced them five times in the FA Cup, winning four, while our only Full Members’ Cup meeting ended in defeat on penalties. 	The Blues have won our past five meetings with Luton, starting with the 1994 FA Cup semi-final at Wembley. We then beat the Hatters in the FA Cup in both 2021 and 2022, before completing a Premier League double over them in 2023/24.	Luton’s last win at Stamford Bridge was 3-1 in September 1986 in the old First Division. Kerry Dixon scored our goal in front of just over 13,000 fans. Joao Pedro’s opener against Fulham, timed at 31 seconds, was our quickest goal since October 2016, when Pedro scored against Manchester United at Stamford Bridge after 30 seconds. The Blues went on to win 4-0 on that occasion. This will be Chelsea’s third appearance in the League Cup second round in the past 30 years. The previous two both came at Stamford Bridge - a 3-2 win over Bristol Rovers in 2016 and a 2-1 victory against Wimbledon in 2023. Chelsea have advanced from 27 of our last 28 League Cup ties against teams from outside the top flight, including each of the last 19, since losing on penalties to Burnley in November 2008. Chelsea last went out in the League Cup second round in 1995/96, losing to Stoke City over two legs. After a goalless draw at the Victoria Ground, we were beaten 1-0 at Stamford Bridge. The last time Chelsea were eliminated from the competition by a lower-division side was in the fourth round in November 2008, when we lost 5-4 on penalties to Burnley after a 1-1 draw. Thursday’s game will be Chelsea’s 107th League Cup match at Stamford Bridge, having won 69 per cent of the previous 106 (five after a penalty shootout). Chelsea lost our most recent Carabao Cup home match, against Arsenal in last season’s semi-final first leg. Our previous defeat at Stamford Bridge in the competition came against Manchester United in 2019. If the aggregate scores are level after 90 minutes, the tie will be decided on penalties as there is no extra time in this competition until the semi-final stage. It has been nearly three years since our last penalty shootout, when we beat Newcastle United 4-2 in the League Cup quarter-final in December 2023. Last Saturday they drew 2-2 with Notts County at Kenilworth Road. They are third in League One after two rounds of games. The Hatters beat League Two side Gillingham 3-0 away in the Carabao Cup first round. Their scorers were Nahki Wells, Benny Benagr and Gideon Kodua. Luton ended last season with three straight wins and have won two and drawn one this term, extending their unbeaten run to 15 matches since their last defeat on 7 March. After their 2023/24 Premier League campaign, Luton suffered back-to-back relegations into League One, before missing out on the play-offs last season by just one point. The most recent occasion Luton were involved in a shootout was in December last year, when they lost 4-2 on penalties to Fleetwood in the FA Cup second round. Luton have been eliminated from eight of their past nine ties against Premier League opponents in the League Cup. The Hatters have progressed from three of their last four Carabao Cup second-round ties, but lost on penalties to Queens Park Rangers in their most recent appearance at this stage, in 2024/25. Former Blues academy players Kasey Palmer and George Saville play for Luton. Jack Wilshere has never managed a side against Chelsea. As a player against the Blues, he won three games with two draws and seven defeats between 2010 and 2020, with Bolton Wanderers, Arsenal, Bournemouth and West Ham United. Since being appointed manager last October, Wilshere has recorded a 52 per cent win rate and led Luton to EFL Trophy victory at Wembley in April. 战平诺茨郡队。经过两轮比赛，他们在甲级联赛中排名第三。联赛杯首轮比赛中，帽子队客场3-0击败乙级联赛球队吉林汉姆。他们的得分手是纳基·威尔斯、本尼·贝纳格和吉迪恩·科杜阿。卢顿上赛季取得三连胜，本赛季取得两胜一平，自3月7日上次失利以来，他们的不败纪录扩大到15场。 2023/24赛季英超联赛结束后，卢顿连续降级至英甲联赛，上赛季仅以一分之差错失附加赛。卢顿最近一次参与点球大战是在去年12月，当时他们在足总杯第二轮点球大战中2-4输给了弗利特伍德。 news.title: Axel Disasi completes Crystal Palace loan switch
news.title_zh: 阿克塞尔·迪萨西完成租借水晶宫
news.body_en: Chelsea defender Axel Disasi has joined Crystal Palace on loan for the 2026/27 season. The centre-back moved to Stamford Bridge from AS Monaco in August 2023 and has made more than 60 appearances in blue. The France international started our first eight matches in the victorious UEFA Conference League campaign in 2024/25, before finishing the season on loan at Aston Villa. Disasi then spent the second half of last season on loan at West Ham, starting 16 of their 17 matches in all competitions. Everyone at Chelsea wishes Axel well and looks forward to following his progress during his time with Crystal Palace.
news.body_zh: 切尔西后卫阿克塞尔·迪萨西于 2026/27 赛季租借加盟水晶宫。这位中后卫于 2023 年 8 月从摩纳哥转会至斯坦福桥，并已代表蓝色出场超过 60 场。这位法国国脚在2024/25赛季胜利的欧洲联盟联赛中首发了前八场比赛，然后租借到阿斯顿维拉结束了这个赛季。迪萨西上赛季后半段被租借到西汉姆联，在所有比赛的 17 场比赛中首发了 16 场。切尔西的每个人都祝愿阿克塞尔一切顺利，并期待着他在水晶宫期间的进步。

news.title: Chelsea’s fastest Premier League goals
news.title_zh: 切尔西最快的英超进球
news.body_en: Joao Pedro gave Chelsea an early lead inside the first minute at Fulham, adding his name to the list of the Blues’ fastest scorers in the Premier League. The Brazilian opened the scoring with just 31 seconds on the clock at Craven Cottage on Monday night, breaking clear from Cole Palmer’s flick to make a flying start to the 2026/27 campaign and set us on our way to a 3-2 victory. It was officially the earliest goal ever on the Premier League’s opening weekend, but only good enough to come sixth on the all-time list of Chelsea’s fastest goalscorers in that competition. Here are the five players who found the net quicker for the Blues in the Premier League… Chelsea blew Man Utd away on Jose Mourinho’s return to Stamford Bridge with the Red Devils. It was Pedro who got the ball rolling on the thrashing when the visiting defenders dawdled in a moment of miscommunication. There was no such hesitancy from our Spanish forward, who took full advantage to round the keeper and slot in. It wasn’t to be Chelsea’s day, as Arsenal came back to take the win at Stamford Bridge and go seven points clear at the top of the Premier League table, but we had got off to the best possible start. That came when Gudjohnsen showed his instincts in the box to control Geremi’s cross brilliantly and fire the opening goal past the keeper. Manchester United’s run of 29 games without defeat came to an emphatic end at Stamford Bridge, as Chelsea turned on the style. The Blues went on the attack right from kick-off, giving Dan Petrescu the chance to cross. When United goalkeeper Massimo Taibi came to collect but collided with one of his defenders, Poyet gratefully headed into the empty net. The Blues were heavy favourites against newly-promoted Nottingham Forest when we met at the Bridge early in the 1998/99 campaign, despite the visitors' decent start to the season. We underlined that status early on, though, with a goal all of Zola’s own making. It was his cross into the box from a throw-in on the left which created the chance. When Forest failed to clear their lines, the Italian was there following in on his own cross to place a first-time finish into the bottom corner. Chelsea had lost two home games in a row when Leicester came to Stamford Bridge looking to be the next visiting side to inflict pain on the Blues. This time we raced into an early, and unassailable, lead. An early foul gifted us a free-kick on the halfway line and Dennis Wise took the chance to run clear into space. He then picked out a teasing angled cross to the back post, where Spencer floated in the air to meet it and head down into the net.
news.body_zh: 若奥·佩德罗在对阵富勒姆的比赛中开场第一分钟就帮助切尔西取得领先，他也因此被列入了英超联赛中蓝军最快得分手的名单中。周一晚上，这位巴西人在克雷文小屋比赛还剩 31 秒时就率先破门，从科尔·帕尔默 (Cole Palmer) 的射门中突破，为 2026/27 赛季开局，帮助我们以 3-2 取得胜利。这正式是英超联赛揭幕周末历史上最早的进球，但仅够在切尔西队史上最快进球者名单上排名第六。以下是在英超联赛中为蓝军更快进球的五名球员……穆里尼奥带领红魔重返斯坦福桥后，切尔西击败了曼联。当客队后卫在沟通不畅时磨蹭时，是佩德罗在殴打中将球滚动。我们的西班牙前锋没有如此犹豫，他充分利用了绕过门将的机会并射门。这不是切尔西的一天，阿森纳在斯坦福桥拿下胜利，在英超联赛积分榜上领先七分，但我们已经取得了最好的开局。当古德约翰森在禁区内展现出他的直觉时，他出色地控制了格雷米的传中，并射出了门将的进球。曼联的 29 场不败纪录在斯坦福桥终结，切尔西开启了这种风格。蓝军一开球就发起进攻，给了丹·佩特雷斯库传中的机会。当曼联门将马西莫·泰比前来接球但与一名后卫相撞时，波耶特感激地头球攻入空门。 1998/99赛季初期，当我们在蓝桥交锋时，蓝军是对阵升班马诺丁汉森林队的热门球队，尽管客队本赛季开局不错。不过，我们很早就强调了这一地位，目标完全是佐拉自己创造的。正是他从左侧掷界外球传入禁区，创造了机会。当森林队未能清除对方防线时，意大利人接应自己的传中，首次将球射入底角。当莱斯特城来到斯坦福桥时，切尔西已经连续输掉了两场主场比赛，他们希望成为下一个给蓝军带来痛苦的客队。这次我们一早就取得了无可争议的领先优势。早些时候的一次犯规让我们在中场线获得了一个任意球，丹尼斯·怀斯抓住机会跑向空位。然后他挑出一记挑衅性的斜传球到后门柱，斯宾塞漂浮在空中接球，头球入网。

news.title: Chelsea and FPT extend strategic partnership into 2026/27 season
news.title_zh: 切尔西与 FPT 将战略合作伙伴关系延续至 2026/27 赛季
news.body_en: Chelsea Football Club and Global Technology Services provider FPT Corporation today announce the extension of our existing partnership for the 2026/27 season. Since first joining forces in 2025, Chelsea and FPT have worked closely together to transform the club’s digital capabilities and enhance the club’s fan engagement to bring Chelsea fans across the world closer to club. With FPT’s market-leading technology solutions and expertise, together Chelsea and FPT have delivered on a number of key projects. Megastore Express – a new mobile-first click-and-collect system – was unveiled in January and streamlines the retail experience for fans on matchdays. A new Official Supporters Club platform was also launched earlier this year and has become the new home for fans from across the world to build supporter groups, join in club activities and be a part of the Chelsea community. These transformative initiatives are a marker of our shared vision to enhance how the club engages with our ever-growing global fan base, enriching the fan experience at Stamford Bridge and beyond. The extension of this partnership is a celebration of the significant progress FPT and Chelsea have made together and marks a renewed commitment to continue the club’s digital transformation journey. Oli Boden, partnership sales director at Chelsea FC, said: 'At Chelsea we are continually focused on innovating and unlocking the opportunities technology and AI-based solutions present to grow our digital presence and bring our fans closer to the club. ‘Together we have delivered significant projects that have transformed the way in which fans can engage with the club. As we embark on the next stage of our partnership with FPT, we reaffirm our commitment to accelerating innovation and enriching the fan experience for our supporters at home and abroad.’‘This partnership reaffirms the qualities that Chelsea FC saw in FPT from the beginning: the ability to deliver at speed and scale, a co-creation mindset, and an AI-driven approach to innovation,’ said Mark Scrivens, CEO of FPT in the United Kingdom. ‘Our teams will continue working side by side to turn ambitious concepts into live, fan-focused solutions, which is a testament to the talent, agility, and engineering excellence of our people, and demonstrates how FPT helps organisations accelerate transformation while remaining focused on delivering measurable outcomes.’
news.body_zh: 切尔西足球俱乐部和全球技术服务提供商 FPT Corporation 今天宣布将我们现有的合作伙伴关系延长至 2026/27 赛季。自 2025 年首次联手以来，切尔西和 FPT 一直密切合作，以转变俱乐部的数字能力并提高俱乐部的球迷参与度，从而拉近世界各地的切尔西球迷与俱乐部的距离。凭借 FPT 市场领先的技术解决方案和专业知识，Chelsea 和 FPT 共同交付了许多关键项目。 Megastore Express——一种新的移动优先点击取货系统——于一月份推出，简化了球迷在比赛日的零售体验。今年早些时候还推出了新的官方支持者俱乐部平台，该平台已成为来自世界各地的球迷建立支持者团体、参加俱乐部活动并成为切尔西社区一部分的新家。这些变革性举措标志着我们共同的愿景，即加强俱乐部与不断增长的全球球迷群体的互动，丰富斯坦福桥及其他地区的球迷体验。此次合作伙伴关系的延长是对 FPT 和切尔西共同取得的重大进展的庆祝，并标志着俱乐部继续数字化转型之旅的新承诺。切尔西足球俱乐部合作伙伴销售总监奥利·博登 (Oli Boden) 表示：“在切尔西，我们不断致力于创新和释放技术和基于人工智能的解决方案所带来的机会，以扩大我们的数字化影响力，拉近我们的球迷与俱乐部的距离。” “我们共同完成了一些重大项目，改变了球迷与俱乐部互动的方式。当我们开始与 FPT 的下一阶段合作时，我们重申致力于加速创新并丰富国内外球迷的体验。”英国 FPT 首席执行官 Mark Scrivens 表示，“此次合作重申了切尔西足球俱乐部从一开始就在 FPT 中看到的品质：快速和大规模交付的能力、共同创造的思维方式以及人工智能驱动的创新方法。” “我们的团队将继续并肩工作，将雄心勃勃的概念转化为以粉丝为中心的实时解决方案，这证明了我们员工的才华、敏捷性和卓越的工程能力，并展示了 FPT 如何帮助组织加速转型，同时保持专注于交付可衡量的成果。”

news.title_zh: 卡拉宝杯第三轮抽签：如何观看、可能的对手、球数、比赛日期
news.body_en: Chelsea will discover our potential Carabao Cup third-round opponents on Wednesday evening, ahead of our involvement in the competition beginning against Luton Town the following day. The Blues begin this season's Carabao Cup campaign in the second round, when we host the Hatters at Stamford Bridge on Thursday night, with kick-off at 7.30pm. Before we take to the pitch for that game, the opponents awaiting the winner in the next round will already be known... The draw for the third round will take place on Wednesday 26 August, following the conclusion of Preston North End's second-round match against Everton. The draw will be broadcast live on Sky Sports in the UK. We will bring you news of the draw on the Chelsea Official App and website as soon as it is known. The ball numbers for the Carabao Cup third-round draw will be announced on Wednesday 26 August. Every team that progresses from the northern and southern section of the draw remain potential opponents for the third round. The nine Premier League teams competing in Europe will also enter the competition at the third-round stage. There is no north-south split to the draw from the third round on. The only restrictions to the draw are the eight teams competing in the UEFA Champions League and UEFA Europa League being seeded, meaning they cannot face each other, but are not guaranteed a home or away game. That leaves Chelsea with these possible Carabao Cup opponents in the third round, ahead of Wednesday's matches: ArsenalAston VillaBarnsleyBrentfordSheffield UnitedLincoln CityBournemouthBradford City/BurnleyBrighton & Hove AlbionNorwich CityMillwallCrystal PalaceMiddlesbroughFleetwood TownFulham/WimbledonIpswich TownLiverpoolManchester CityManchester UnitedNewcastle United/West Bromwich AlbionLeeds UnitedCoventry CityPreston North End/EvertonWolverhampton WanderersWest Ham UnitedReadingHull CitySunderlandTottenham Hotspur/Charlton AthleticLeyton OrientPeterborough United Third-round ties will be split across two midweek slots to accommodate European fixture commitments, with games played on the weeks beginning 7 September and 14 September.

news.title: PGA South League report: London City Under-21s 0-8 Chelsea Women’s Under-18s
news.title_zh: PGA 南部联赛报告：伦敦城 21 岁以下青年队 0-8 切尔西女子 18 岁以下青年队
news.body_en: Chelsea Women’s Under-18s began their Professional Game Academy South League campaign in impressive fashion, securing an 8-0 victory away at London City Lionesses Under-21s on Wednesday evening. Chelsea Women's Under-18s, who play in the PGA Under-21 Women's League, were ahead inside seven minutes on Wednesday through Stevie Sinclair and established a two-goal advantage before the interval thanks to Maisie Brickell's strike. After the break, Chelsea added six more goals, with Chelsea N'Drin, Sinclair and Brickell all ending the match with two goals, while Jahyma Putman and Tess Finn also added their names to the scoresheet. Chelsea dominated possession throughout and combined attacking quality with defensive discipline to ensure they opened the new league season with both three points and a clean sheet. Chelsea made a positive start and moved in front after seven minutes. Victoria Rudz's clipped pass into the wide channel allowed Brickell to advance down the flank and deliver a cross into the box. Sinclair arrived from midfield and fired home from the edge of the area to give the Blues an early lead. The second goal arrived after 17 minutes and again involved Rudz and Brickell. Spotting space beyond the London City back line, Rudz played forward into the right channel, where Brickell drove towards goal before cutting across her defender and finishing at the near post. Chelsea continued to control possession and territory for the remainder of the first half, limiting opportunities for the hosts while taking a deserved two-goal advantage into the interval. A triple substitution at the break helped maintain Chelsea's momentum and a third goal arrived six minutes into the second half. After Putman switched play to Zoe Ciccardini, the defender found Sinclair's run in behind. The goalkeeper showed bravery to deny Sinclair's initial effort, but N'Drin reacted quickest to convert the rebound. Chelsea continued to press aggressively and nearly extended the lead further when N'Drin was brought down in the penalty area after a high regain. Sinclair's resulting penalty was saved, but the Blues were adding to the scoresheet once again soon after. The fourth goal arrived on 76 minutes when combinations around the edge of the box by Finn and N’Drin helped create space for Sinclair, who took a touch beyond the last defender before finishing confidently. A minute later Chelsea struck again. Finn recovered possession high up the pitch and switched play to Putman, who advanced towards goal before spinning past the goalkeeper and calmly finishing into an empty net. Finn then added her own name to the scoresheet on 86 minutes. After some quick combinations the ball was worked wide to Putman at left wing, she showed positive 1v1 play to get to the byline to pull the ball back to the edge of the box for the arriving Finn, who’s placed shot to the goalkeeper’s right added another. Three minutes later, N’Drin and Gregory helped win possession high up the pitch and the latter played into Brickell on the edge of the box. She turned and placed a composed finish across goal for Chelsea's seventh. There was still time for one more. Deep into added time, Sinclair dropped low to combine with Ciccardini, who was able to find Storey inside the pitch, with good vision and quick play. Storey played forward through the defensive line of London City Lionesses to find Brickell in the wide area. After some more positive play, Brickell delivered a lofted cross into the box which was met by N’Drin in the air to score the final goal. The result means Chelsea Women Under-18s sit top of the Professional Game Academy South League table thanks to their eight-goal winning margin. Chelsea's next fixture sees us travel to face Wycombe Wanderers Women in the senior Women's National League Cup on Thursday. The Blues then return to Professional Game Academy South League action on Sunday 30 August when Crystal Palace visit. Chelsea Women Under-18s (4-3-3): Victoria Rudz; Elise Christian, Sophie Leach, Zoe Ciccardini, Maisie Brickell; Belle Sullivan © (Sadie Gregory 70’), Stevie Sinclair, Keira Johnson (Tess Finn 45’); Rebekah Pierce (Jahyma Putman 45’), Carla Gardiner (Chelsea N’Drin 45’), Aysia Matabaro (Gabi Storey 45’) Scorers: Sinclair 7, 76; Brickell 17, 89; N'Drin 51, 90+5; Putman 77; Finn 86
news.body_zh: 切尔西女子 18 岁以下队以令人印象深刻的方式开始了职业比赛学院南联赛的征程，周三晚客场以 8-0 战胜伦敦城狮队 21 岁以下队。参加 PGA 21 岁以下女子联赛的切尔西 18 岁以下女子队在周三的七分钟内就通过史蒂夫·辛克莱 (Stevie Sinclair) 领先，并在中场休息前凭借麦茜·布里克尔 (Maisie Brickell) 的进球确立了两球优势。中场休息后，切尔西又进了六个进球，恩德林、辛克莱和布里克尔均以两球结束了比赛，而贾希玛·普特曼和泰斯·芬恩也将自己的名字写入了进球表。切尔西自始至终都掌控着控球权，并将进攻质量与防守纪律相结合，确保他们以三分和不失球的成绩开启新赛季。切尔西开局积极，七分钟后就取得领先。维多利亚·鲁兹（Victoria Rudz）的短传球进入宽阔的通道，使布里克尔（Brickell）能够沿着侧翼推进并将传中球送入禁区。辛克莱从中场赶来，在禁区边缘射门，让蓝军早早取得领先。第 17 分钟后，鲁兹和布里克尔再次进球。鲁兹发现了伦敦城队后防线之外的空间，向前冲入右路，布里克尔带球冲向球门，然后越过防守球员，射入近门柱。切尔西在上半场余下的时间里继续控制着控球权和地盘，限制了主队的机会，同时在中场休息时取得了当之无愧的两球优势。中场休息时的三次换人帮助切尔西保持了势头，下半场六分钟后第三个进球到来。在普特曼将比赛换给佐伊·西卡迪尼后，这名后卫发现辛克莱尔在后面跑动。门将表现出勇敢，挡住了辛克莱最初的射门，但恩德林反应最快，将篮板球转化为球。切尔西继续积极施压，恩德林在禁区内高位扳平后被放倒，险些扩大领先优势。辛克莱的点球被扑出，但蓝军很快就再次进球。第四个进球出现在第 76 分钟，芬恩和恩德林在禁区边缘的配合为辛克莱创造了空间，辛克莱在最后一名后卫身后触球，然后自信地射门。一分钟后，切尔西再次破门。芬恩在高位夺回控球权，并将比赛交给普特曼，普特曼冲向球门，然后转身越过了门将，冷静地射入空门。第 86 分钟，芬恩将自己的名字添加到了记分表上。经过一些快速组合后，球传给了左翼的普特曼，她表现出了积极的一对一表现，到达边线，将球拉回禁区边缘，交给到达的芬恩，芬恩在守门员右侧射门又进一球。三分钟后，恩德林和格雷戈里在高位帮助赢得控球权，格雷戈里在禁区边缘传球给布里克尔。她转身冷静地射门，为切尔西打入第七球。还有时间再来一件事。补时阶段，辛克莱尔低位与西卡迪尼配合，西卡迪尼凭借良好的视野和快速的进攻找到了内线的斯托里。斯托里向前突破伦敦城母狮队的防线，在边路找到布里克尔。经过一些积极的比赛后，布里克尔将一记高高传中送入禁区，恩德林在空中接应，打进了最后一球。这一结果意味着切尔西 18 岁以下女子队凭借 8 球的优势位居职业比赛学院南联赛积分榜榜首。切尔西的下一场比赛将于周四在高级女子国家联赛杯中迎战韦科姆流浪者女足。随后，蓝军将在 8 月 30 日星期日重返职业比赛学院南联赛，届时水晶宫将作客。切尔西 18 岁以下女子队 (4-3-3)：维多利亚·鲁兹；埃莉斯·克里斯蒂安、索菲·利奇、佐伊·西卡迪尼、麦茜·布里克尔； Belle Sullivan © (Sadie Gregory 70’)、Stevie Sinclair、Keira Johnson (Tess Finn 45’)；丽贝卡·皮尔斯 (Jahyma Putman 45’)、卡拉·加德纳 (Chelsea N’Drin 45’)、艾西亚·马塔巴罗 (Gabi Storey 45’) 进球者：辛克莱 7、76；布里克尔 17, 89;恩德林 51, 90+5;普特曼77；芬恩86

Chelsea take on Arsenal in the Premier League on Sunday 6 September with a 4.30pm kick-off at the Emirates Stadium. Ticket sales for this match will be as follows: As tickets for this match are being sold on a loyalty-point basis and the match takes place in the first month of the season, loyalty points accrued during the previous season will be taken into account. Wednesday 26 August from 10am until 11:30am: Tickets will be sold to members with 113 loyalty points or more who can purchase one ticket per person. Wednesday 26 August from 12pm until 1:30pm: Tickets will be sold to members with 108 loyalty points or more who can purchase one ticket per person. Wednesday 26 August from 2pm until 3.30pm: Tickets will be sold to members with 103 loyalty points or more who can purchase one ticket per person. Wednesday 26 August from 4pm: All remaining members who have yet to purchase can purchase one ticket per person. Tickets will be sold online only. Supporters who require accessible tickets can submit an application form found here during the selling period. Alternatively, supporters if they are able to do so, can call our Access Team on 0371 811 2012 or 0044 207 915 1950 (international callers) to reserve tickets and request further information. Personal assistant tickets can only be allocated using this process. The Emirates Stadium has up to six accessible spaces. Please contact the access team at access@chelseafc.com to reserve a space. Supporters will need to provide their car registration number along with the name of the Blue Badge holder and need to confirm they are happy for this and their email address/contact number to be passed to Arsenal. The entire allocation for this fixture will be in digital form. This will be clearly marked on the online portal, so supporters can be aware that they are purchasing tickets in this format. Tickets will be sent from Wednesday 2 September, via email. Supporters who do not receive their tickets should email the ticket office on Friday 4 September no later than 12pm. Please note that away duplicate tickets can only be collected by supporters in the booking. Loyalty points will continue to be awarded for purchasing away tickets. For the 2026/27 season, away ticket holders will only be able to pass on their ticket to an existing eligible member/season ticket holder who does not already have a ticket for this fixture. When doing so, they will be required to provide the name and membership number of the supporter who is using the ticket to the club via an online form. The form will be active on Wednesday 2 September from 4pm, to access the form, please click here. Away ticket holders will be able to transfer their ticket up to six times per season. Digital and in-person spot checks will be carried out to ensure the correct information has been provided to the club. More information will be provided once the sales process is completed. Away match tickets are not refundable. news.title: Premier League ticket news: Hull at home - ticket application window closing
news.title_zh: 英超联赛门票新闻：赫尔城主场 - 门票申请窗口关闭
news.body_en: Ticket sales information has been released for our second home Premier League match of the season. The Blues host Hull City at Stamford Bridge on Saturday 12 September with a 3pm kick-off. Supporters intending to travel to or from this game using the London Underground are advised that planned engineering works may affect your journey. There will be no District Line service between Tower Hill and Edgware Road to Wimbledon, Kensington (Olympia), Richmond and Ealing Broadway stations. This means Fulham Broadway Station will be closed all day and there will be no District Line trains running to any nearby stations on that branch of the tube network. There is also no Circle Line from Edgware Road to Aldgate (via Victoria). Home tickets for members for men’s team matches are now allocated through a new application process. For each home match, eligible members have a designated application window during which they can apply for tickets. Applications can be made individually or as a group, provided all members of the group are eligible to apply during that window. Tickets will be allocated one per person with a maximum of four per application. Ticket application window opens – Friday 21 August 12pm Ticket application window closes – Wednesday 26 August 12pm The Ticket application window will be open for True Blue+, True Blue, CFC Blue, and Junior Blue members. As part of the verification process, a pre-authorisation charge £0.01 will be applied to validate your payment card. No money will be taken at this stage, and the hold will be removed by your provider. Tickets for this match are priced at Category B. Please click here for match ticket prices Tickets will appear on the Chelsea Official App prior to the event. Eligible members can submit their application through the ticketing portal at any time during the window, supporters must ensure they are logged in to successfully apply. Applying earlier does not increase the likelihood of success, giving supporters greater flexibility to apply at a time that suits them. As part of the new ticket sales process, members who are eligible for concession-rate tickets are automatically assigned their price class. To ensure you are receiving the correct ticket, please take the time to check the date of birth on your account is accurate. You will only be allocated tickets in your selected areas unless you choose to be considered for other available options. If you only wish to be entered for tickets in one area of the stadium, please leave the second option blank. Please read the ticket application information carefully before submitting your application. Successful and unsuccessful applications will be notified by email within four working days of the ticket application window closing date. Successful applications will be charged to their payment card approximately at this time. Supporters are not able to use account credit for ticket application window purchases. Tickets are for Chelsea supporters only. All persons under the age of 16 will be required to attend with and sit next to, a person aged 18 years of age or over. Members and season ticket holders can purchase Westview tickets for Premier League home games via the Chelsea FC Official Ticketing Portal. A maximum of four tickets can be bought per person, and only the ticket purchaser is required to be a member or season ticket holder. You are not required to be a member or season ticket holder to purchase non-Westview Club Chelsea packages. Club Chelsea tickets are non-refundable unless the match is cancelled, postponed, or moved more than 48 hours either side of the scheduled fixture date. All Club Chelsea ticket purchases are subject to Club Chelsea terms and conditions. For any further Westview enquiries, please email clubchelsea@chelseafc.com. Loyalty points will now only be awarded for attendance at men’s first-team home matches and no longer accrued for purchasing tickets. Points will be added to eligible accounts following each game, provided the ticket has been scanned at the turnstile. This means that supporters purchasing tickets on the ticket exchange, or receiving tickets via ticket forwarding, will now receive loyalty points for attending matches. Supporters will receive three loyalty points for attending this match. Points will be applied after the fixture has been played. Members can still purchase general admission tickets if available in line with the General Admission Policy. Supporters who require accessible tickets can apply through the accessible ticket application window. news.title: EFL Trophy: Bristol Rovers 2-2 Cobham Next Gen (2-4 on pens)
news.title_zh: EFL奖杯：布里斯托尔流浪者队2-2科巴姆下一代（笔杆2-4）
news.body_en: Cobham Next Gen showed real heart as we came from two goals down to beat Bristol Rovers on penalties in our opening EFL Trophy fixture. The hosts led at the interval through Mees Rijks and extended their advantage via Joe Quigley shortly before the hour mark, despite the Blues enjoying most of the possession. Sol Gordon then created Harrison Bettoni’s 71st-minute goal before Chizaram Ezenwata drew us level in the closing stages. Freddy Bernal had kept Chelsea in the contest with several important saves and denied Jack Sparkes during the shoot-out, before Justin Osagie scored the decisive spot-kick to help us secure two points and go top in Southern Group C. Gordon had the first sight of goal after eight minutes, letting fly from the right side of the penalty area but sending his effort wide. Bernal produced a couple of important early saves to keep the contest close, but Bristol Rovers opened the scoring in the 22nd minute. Ryan de Havilland played the ball forward to Jack Aitchison, whose pass across goal was converted by Rijks. Chelsea had an opportunity to respond soon afterwards when Gordon won possession from Sparkes and found Ezenwata, but the forward was unable to take the chance. Harry Hudson made a double change in the 56th minute, introducing Lewi Richards and Mahdi Nicoll-Jazuli in place of Calvin Diakite and Harrison McMahon. Two minutes later, a cross the Blues were unable to clear reached Quigley at the far post and the striker finished to double the hosts’ advantage. Chelsea, who saw Andrew Pennie replace Jashayde Greenwood shortly after the hour mark, reduced the deficit in the 71st minute. Gordon beat Sparkes and drove to the byline before cutting the ball back for Bettoni, who finished first time. Bettoni found space again soon afterwards and went close to an equaliser. That second goal arrived in the 82nd minute. Nicoll-Jazuli’s neat spin created the opening and Ezenwata found the corner to bring the Blues level. Chelsea went in search of the winner and Pennie struck the side-netting in the second minute of stoppage time but the contest went to penalties. Ezenwata and Bettoni converted spot-kicks to help the Blues go 2-1 ahead, after Bernal saved from Sparkes. Richards then scored to make it 3-2 in the shootout and when Richard Smallwood failed to convert, it left Osagie to calmly seal a 4-2 shoot-out victory. Cobham Next Gen begin our EFL Trophy campaign with two points, earning one for the draw after 90 minutes and securing the bonus point through our shoot-out success. news.body_zh: 科巴姆下一代表现出了真正的决心，我们在两球落后的情况下在英格兰足球联赛杯首场比赛中通过点球大战击败了布里斯托尔流浪者队。尽管蓝军占据了大部分控球权，但主队在中场休息时通过米斯·里克斯(Mees Rijks)取得领先，并在比赛开始前不久通过乔·奎格利(Joe Quigley)扩大了优势。随后索尔·戈登在第 71 分钟创造了哈里森·贝托尼的进球，随后奇扎拉姆·埃森瓦塔在最后阶段将我们扳平。弗雷迪·伯纳尔（Freddy Bernal）在比赛中做出了几次重要的扑救，并在点球大战中挡出了杰克·斯帕克斯（Jack Sparkes）的大门，随后贾斯汀·奥萨吉（Justin Osagie）打进了决定性的点球，帮助我们获得了两分，并在南C组中排名第一。戈登在八分钟后第一次看到进球，他从禁区右侧射门，但射门偏出。伯纳尔在早期做出了几次重要的扑救，让比赛继续胶着，但布里斯托尔流浪者队在第 22 分钟首开纪录。瑞恩·德·哈维兰将球传给杰克·艾奇森，后者的传球被里克斯完成。很快，切尔西就有机会做出回应，戈登从斯帕克斯手中夺回控球权并找到了埃森瓦塔，但前锋没能抓住这个机会。哈里·哈德森在第56分钟做出双重换人，用刘易斯·理查兹和马赫迪·尼科尔-贾祖利代替卡尔文·迪亚基特和哈里森·麦克马洪。两分钟后，蓝军无法清除的传中传到远门柱的奎格利，这位前锋将主队的优势扩大了一倍。切尔西在比赛结束后不久就看到安德鲁·佩尼 (Andrew Pennie) 替换贾沙伊德·格林伍德 (Jashayde Greenwood)，并在第 71 分钟缩小了比分差距。戈登击败斯帕克斯，带球突破底线，然后将球切回给贝托尼，贝托尼率先完成比赛。贝托尼很快再次找到空档，差点扳平比分。第二个进球是在第 82 分钟打进的。尼科尔-贾祖利的漂亮旋转创造了空档，而埃森瓦塔找到了角球，将蓝军扳平。切尔西寻求制胜球，佩尼在补时第二分钟击中边网，但比赛进入点球大战。在伯纳尔扑出斯帕克斯的球后，埃森瓦塔和贝托尼主罚点球帮助蓝军2-1领先。理查兹随后在点球大战中得分将比分改写为3-2，而当理查德·斯莫尔伍德未能成功转换时，奥萨吉冷静地以4-2锁定了点球大战的胜利。科巴姆下一代以两分开始我们的 EFL 奖杯征程，在 90 分钟后的平局中赢得一分，并通过点球大战的成功获得奖励积分。科巴姆下一代重返英超 2 级联赛，我们本赛季的第一场主场比赛将于 8 月 31 日星期一在 Kingsmeadow 对阵西汉姆联 21 岁以下青年队。下午 1 点开始。切尔西：50.弗雷迪·伯纳尔，37.奥鲁塔约·苏布洛耶，47.哈里森·麦克马洪（32.马赫迪·尼科尔-贾祖利 56），48.贾斯汀·奥萨吉，52.哈里森·贝托尼，55.索尔·戈登，58.卡尔文·迪亚基特（67.刘易·理查兹 56），62.奇扎拉姆·埃森瓦塔，63. news.title: Three Blues named in PFA WSL Team of the Year for 2025/26
news.title_zh: 三支蓝军入选 PFA WSL 2025/26 年度最佳阵容
news.body_en: Three Chelsea players have been named in the PFA Women's Super League Team of the Year for the 2025/26 campaign, which was revealed at an awards ceremony at Manchester Opera House this evening. With the Blues preparing for tomorrow evening's UEFA Champions League qualifying round first leg against Real Sociedad – which can be viewed live on the Chelsea Official App and website – neither Sonia Bompastor nor her players attended the event. Yet that did not stop the performances of a trio of our players last season from being recognised by their fellow professionals. Hannah Hampton secured the goalkeeper spot in the Team of the Year, having kept eight clean sheets in 18 league appearances during the previous campaign. The PFA WSL Team of the Year in association with Care Fertility 🏆Voted for by the players. pic.twitter.com/94iUFmy5wA Fellow Blue and England international Lauren James was also handed a place in the side, having been voted by fans as our Player of the Season last year. Our No.10 scored several sublime goals last term, netting five times in 14 domestic games, and also went past the 100-appearance marker in blue. The third and final place in the WSL Team of the Year for a Chelsea player was Ellie Carpenter, who impressed throughout her maiden campaign in the English game. The Australian international made 19 appearances in the top flight last term, scoring twice and providing two assists. Several Blues received nominations for awards prior to Tuesday's ceremony. James was shortlisted for the PFA WSL Player of the Year honour, which went to Manchester City's Bunny Shaw, while Veerle Buurman and Alyssa Thompson were up for the PFA WSL Young Player of the Year. Be there to welcome our award-winners to our new home at Stamford Bridge when we take on Aston Villa in our first Women's Super League match of the season on 5 September at 12.35pm!

news.title: Key talking points from Bompastor and Bronze ahead of Real Sociedad
news.title_zh: 皇家社会之前邦帕斯托和青铜的关键谈话要点
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor and Lucy Bronze faced the media at Cobham this afternoon ahead of our Women's Champions League qualifier clash against Real Sociedad on Wednesday night. The Blues are looking to gain an advantage in the first leg at home in our maiden match at the Cherry Red Records Stadium, before heading to Spain for the return leg on 2 September. Tickets are still available for Wednesday's game, and you can purchase them here. Alongside the latest injury news provided by Bompastor, here is a rundown of the other major talking points from today's press conference... Sonia Bompastor: It will be a strong test. Real Sociedad finished third in the Liga F. They are a Spanish team, so they have a really strong philosophy in possession, but they have a lot of quality out of possession as well. We know everything about them now, and we prepared for the game well. But the game tomorrow will also be about us, and I'm confident with the quality we have shown during pre-season. Lucy Bronze: I remember playing against Real Sociedad in Liga F when I was at Barcelona, and they were always a good team. They always played good football. We had good results against them, but I always remember them being a really good team, something that me and Keira (Walsh) both spoke about recently. I actually watched the game last year when they were playing against Barca. They defended really well, which isn't the easiest thing to do against Barca when they were continually attacking. SB: Pre-season has been really good. We have worked really hard with a lot of intensity in training sessions. We travelled all over the world, and it was a really good opportunity for the squad to be together and for us to get to know each other better. Since we came back, we also recovered really well from the travel, but we got back to business, and I think we are in a really good place for the game tomorrow. LB: We've got a lot of young, talented players at Chelsea, a lot of eager players who are keen to learn and to listen. Sometimes they get things wrong, but they try really hard, and it's exciting to be part of the club and to see so many players grow, develop and improve every day. I think that's the exciting part of this team this year: the youth and the exuberance we will have on the pitch. LB: I think it's fun. We like playing against teams from different countries. The league phase last year was different, and I guess this is just another difference, but we're very much focused on this game. We know it's very important for us to win tomorrow, especially playing at home. We don't take anything for granted. We know what a good team they are. I think having more games this year is exciting for us as Chelsea, and being in a different position just allows you to adapt and learn new things about the team. LB: People forget how much spotlight was put on her from a very young age. But I think in the team at Chelsea, you can see she feels comfortable. She's grown as a player. She's grown as a person. You can see that she's grown so many connections with all of the team. We all know that when LJ is flowing, there's nobody in the world that can stop her. So it's nice to see that she's growing a lot. SB: As a coach, I'm someone who really cares about the players, but as a human, I also care about the humans and the person. So I think in this environment, I always try my best to encourage the players to be themselves and to express themselves. It's okay for us to be vulnerable sometimes. We spend so much time together, so I'm happy with what Lucy said in terms of allowing people to be themselves, in terms of vulnerability, but also when they are showing confidence, it's something good. LB: Pre-season has gone so well. The new signings are fitting in really well too. It just feels like we're on a fresh start. We have kind of put a line in the sand from last season, and moving forward to be even bigger and better than Chelsea's ever been. Be there to welcome CFCW to our new home at Stamford Bridge when we take on Aston Villa in our first Women's Super League match of the season on 5 September at 12.35pm!
news.body_zh: 今天下午，索尼娅·邦帕斯托和露西·青铜在科巴姆接受了媒体采访，准备周三晚上与皇家社会队进行女子冠军联赛预选赛。蓝军希望在樱桃红唱片体育场举行的首回合主场比赛中获得优势，然后于 9 月 2 日前往西班牙进行第二回合比赛。周三比赛的门票仍然有售，您可以在这里购买。除了 Bompastor 提供的最新伤病消息外，这里还概述了今天新闻发布会上的其他主要话题…… Sonia Bompastor：这将是一次强有力的考验。皇家社会队在西甲联赛中排名第三。他们是一支西班牙球队，因此他们在控球方面拥有很强的理念，但他们在控球方面也有很多实力。我们现在已经了解了他们的一切，并且我们为比赛做好了充分的准备。但明天的比赛也将是我们的比赛，我对我们在季前赛中表现出的实力充满信心。露西·布朗兹：我记得当我在巴塞罗那时，在联赛中对阵皇家社会队，他们一直是一支优秀的球队。他们总是踢出漂亮的足球。我们在对阵他们的比赛中取得了不错的成绩，但我一直记得他们是一支非常优秀的球队，这是我和凯拉（沃尔什）最近都谈到的。事实上，我去年就看过他们对阵巴萨的比赛。他们的防守非常好，当巴萨不断进攻时，这并不是最容易做到的事情。 SB：季前赛真的很棒。我们在训练中非常努力，强度很大。我们走遍了世界各地，这对球队来说是一个很好的机会，让我们能够更好地了解彼此。自从我们回来后，我们也从旅行中恢复得很好，但我们又回到了正事，我认为我们对于明天的比赛处于一个非常好的状态。 LB：我们切尔西有很多年轻、有才华的球员，很多渴望学习和倾听的球员。有时他们会犯错，但他们真的很努力，成为俱乐部的一员并看到这么多球员每天都在成长、发展和提高，这真是令人兴奋。我认为这就是今年这支球队令人兴奋的部分：我们在球场上将充满青春和活力。 LB：我觉得这很有趣。我们喜欢与来自不同国家的球队比赛。去年的联赛阶段有所不同，我想这只是另一个不同，但我们非常关注这场比赛。我们知道明天的胜利对我们来说非常重要，尤其是在主场比赛。我们不认为任何事情是理所当然的。我们知道他们是一支多么优秀的团队。我认为今年有更多的比赛对我们切尔西来说是令人兴奋的，处于不同的位置只会让你适应和了解球队的新事物。 LB：人们忘记了她从很小的时候起就受到了多少关注。但我认为在切尔西的球队中，你可以看到她感觉很舒服。作为一名球员，她已经成长了。她作为一个人已经成长了。您可以看到她与整个团队建立了如此多的联系。我们都知道，当LJ流动时，世界上没有人可以阻止她。所以很高兴看到她成长了很多。 SB：作为一名教练，我是一个真正关心球员的人，但作为一个人，我也关心人类和人。所以我觉得在这样的环境下，我总是尽力鼓励选手们做自己，表达自己。有时我们感到脆弱是没关系的。我们花了很多时间在一起，所以我很高兴露西所说的，让人们做自己，在脆弱方面，而且当他们表现出自信时，这是一件好事。 LB：季前赛进展顺利。新签约的球员也非常适合。感觉就像我们有了一个新的开始。从上个赛季开始，我们已经划定了界限，并继续前进，变得比切尔西以往任何时候都更大、更好。 9 月 5 日中午 12 点 35 分，我们将在本赛季首场女子超级联赛对阵阿斯顿维拉的比赛中欢迎 CFCW 来到我们位于斯坦福桥的新家！

news.title: Analysis: How POTM Cole Palmer inspired Blues to victory
news.title_zh: 分析：POTM 科尔·帕尔默如何激励蓝军取得胜利
news.body_en: We detail the pivotal role Cole Palmer played in helping the Blues get our Premier League campaign up and running with a victory at Fulham. Our No10 was at his very best at Craven Cottage. Palmer assisted and scored a goal in the same Premier League game for the first time since February’s draw with Leeds United, with his cute finish early in the second half ultimately settling the contest. That was one of a game-high five attempts Palmer registered against Fulham, while he also led the way for successful dribbles (five), duels won (10), touches in the opposition box (nine) and fouls won (three). All those statistics point to the intent and confidence with which Palmer played. His nine attempted take-ons showed just how keen he was to beat his man, with one twisting and turning run in the second half nearly culminating in a special solo strike. Xabi Alonso’s system, using Palmer in a pocket alongside Morgan Rogers and off Joao Pedro, helped our No10 receive the ball. He spent more time in possession than every Chelsea outfielder bar Reece James, Josh Acheampong and Morgan Lacroix. Palmer was consistently effective when he had the ball at his feet. His assist for Joao Pedro’s record-breaking goal – the fastest ever scored in the Premier League on an opening weekend – was one of three key passes Palmer played, a figure bettered only by Rogers’ five. In total, Palmer completed 88 per cent of his passes, significantly higher than the team average of 82 per cent. A significant proportion (14) were played in the final third, too, highlighting his willingness to take risks. The weight and direction of Palmer’s passes were pivotal to our first and second goals, while his own strike showed his pinpoint accuracy in front of goal. The angle was narrow, so he aimed to slip the ball through Bernd Leno’s legs – and succeeded. Palmer wasn’t afraid to do his defensive work, either. He won two tackles and recovered possession seven times, including on three occasions in the final third. Those high turnovers proved instrumental for our first two goals of the night. Palmer was ably assisted by Joao Pedro and Rogers. That trio played 20 passes between them and showed signs of an understanding that bodes very well for the future – as does Palmer’s elite display. news.body_zh: 我们详细介绍了科尔·帕尔默在帮助蓝军启动并在富勒姆取得胜利的英超联赛中所发挥的关键作用。我们的 10 号在 Craven Cottage 处于最佳状态。自二月份战平利兹联以来，帕尔默首次在同一场英超比赛中助攻并进球，他在下半场早些时候的可爱射门最终锁定了比赛。这是帕尔默在对阵富勒姆的比赛中全场最高的五次射门之一，同时他还在成功带球（五次）、对抗胜利（十次）、对方禁区触球（九次）和犯规获胜（三次）方面领先。所有这些统计数据都表明了帕尔默打球的意图和信心。他的九次尝试表明了他对击败对手的渴望，下半场的一次转身跑动几乎以一次特殊的单人进攻达到了高潮。哈维·阿隆索的体系，利用帕尔默与摩根·罗杰斯并肩作战，并在若奥·佩德罗的帮助下，帮助我们的 10 号球员接球。除了里斯·詹姆斯、乔什·阿奇姆彭和摩根·拉克鲁瓦之外，他控球的时间比所有切尔西外野手都多。当球在脚下时，帕尔默始终保持高效。他为若奥·佩德罗破纪录的进球（英超联赛首周末进球速度最快的进球）的助攻是帕尔默的三记关键传球之一，这一数字仅次于罗杰斯的五记传球。总的来说，帕尔默的传球完成率为88%，明显高于球队平均水平82%。很大一部分（14）也出现在最后三分之一，这凸显了他愿意冒险的意愿。帕尔默传球的力度和方向对于我们的第一个和第二个进球至关重要，而他自己的射门则显示了他在球门前的精准。角度很窄，所以他打算把球从贝恩德·莱诺的腿上滑过——并且成功了。帕尔默也不害怕做他的防守工作。他赢得了两次铲断并七次夺回控球权，其中三次是在进攻三区。事实证明，这些高失误对我们当晚的前两个进球起到了重要作用。帕尔默得到若昂·佩德罗和罗杰斯的大力协助。这三人一共传球 20 次，表现出默契的迹象，这对未来来说是个好兆头——帕尔默的精英表现也是如此。接下来是周中联赛杯对阵卢顿镇的比赛，以及阿隆索对阵布莱顿的英超主场首秀。立即获得 VIP 体验，与切尔西俱乐部度过难忘的斯坦福桥比赛日！

news.title: Bompastor confirms injured Chelsea trio to miss Real Sociedad game
news.title_zh: 庞帕斯特证实切尔西三人受伤将缺席皇家社会队的比赛
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor has confirmed she will be without the services of three players for the first leg of our Champions League qualifying tie against Real Sociedad. The Blues head coach was joined by Lucy Bronze on Tuesday afternoon to answer the media’s questions ahead of our opening fixture of the 2026/27 campaign, which takes place at the Cherry Red Records Stadium in Wimbledon. It will be streamed for free live on the Chelsea Official App and website. Bompastor will hope to see her side establish a lead ahead of the second leg in Spain next week, but she will not be able to call upon Erin Cuthbert, Mayra Ramirez and Manaka Matsukubo. ‘We have a squad with almost everyone pretty available from pre-season,’ said Bompastor. ‘The ones who are not available are Erin Cuthbert, who had an injury in the last international break and she's recovering from that. We also have Manaka, who won't be available for this game, and Mayra as well, who won't be available for the game. ‘I don't think we could expect to see them for the second leg. I think it'll be a little bit longer, but it's difficult to put a timeframe on it. They are working really well and progressing as we want them to progress, but yeah, no timeframe. ‘Except from these three, everyone else is available.’ Bompastor expanded on Ramirez’s recovery following the serious hamstring injury she suffered this time last year, with the head coach explaining her absence on Wednesday is expected. ‘Mayra is recovering from not having played last season, and I think it's tough sometimes when you haven't played for the full season to be ready to compete. ‘It's part of her rehab plan. She's not quite ready, but we are working closely with her to make sure she returns on the pitch as fit as possible.’
news.body_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯特确认，在欧冠资格赛对阵皇家社会的首回合比赛中，她将缺席三名球员的比赛。周二下午，蓝军主教练露西·青铜在我们 2026/27 赛季揭幕战（在温布尔登樱桃红唱片体育场举行）之前回答了媒体的问题。它将在切尔西官方应用程序和网站上免费直播。邦帕斯托希望看到她的球队在下周西班牙第二回合比赛之前取得领先，但她将无法召唤艾琳·库斯伯特、迈拉·拉米雷斯和马纳卡·松久保。 “我们的阵容中几乎每个人都可以参加季前赛，”邦帕斯特说。 “缺席的是艾琳·库斯伯特，她在上次国际比赛中受伤，目前正在康复中。我们还有 Manaka，他将无法参加这场比赛，还有 Mayra，他也将无法参加这场比赛。 “我认为我们不会期望在第二回合看到他们。我认为会有点长，但很难确定时间表。他们工作得非常好，并且按照我们希望的那样取得进展，但是，是的，没有时间表。 “除了这三个人，其他人都可以上场。”邦帕斯特详细介绍了拉米雷斯去年这个时候腿筋严重受伤后的康复情况，主教练解释说，预计她将在周三缺席。 “梅拉正在从上赛季缺席的比赛中恢复过来，我认为，当你整个赛季都没有参加比赛时，要准备好参加比赛有时会很困难。 “这是她康复计划的一部分。她还没有完全准备好，但我们正在与她密切合作，以确保她尽可能健康地重返球场。

news.title: Joao Pedro on joining Palmer and Rogers in a ‘special’ front three
news.title_zh: 若昂·佩德罗谈与帕尔默和罗杰斯一起组成“特殊”的前三名
news.body_en: Joao Pedro believes Chelsea showed our strength in an impressive opening game of what could be a great season for the Blues, especially with the Brazilian lining up alongside Cole Palmer and Morgan Rogers in a new-look attack. The starting line-up for Xabi Alonso’s first competitive match as Chelsea manager featured a front three of Joao Pedro down the middle, supported either side by Palmer and summer signing Rogers. It proved a big hit on its first outing, with all three of those players getting on the scoresheet as we began our 2026/27 campaign with a 3-2 Premier League win away at neighbours Fulham on Monday evening. That front three is already causing plenty of excitement among the Blues supporters following its debut at Craven Cottage, and it seems to be shared by Joao Pedro after a performance full of movement and clever combinations. ‘Cole and Morgan, they are special players. Everyone knows that,’ said Joao Pedro after Chelsea’s winning start to the season. ‘I'm very grateful to play with them because I know if I make some runs, like yesterday, you know Cole and Morgan are going to give the ball to me, and I have to be ready to score. So it's very special for me to play with them. ‘I just try to enjoy and try to help my team in every game. Then this season, see what I get. I just try to score in every opportunity I have. ‘I’ve known Morgan since a long time ago because we played against each other,' added our new number nine. 'So when he joined the club, I knew it was very good for us because he's a very good player, and I think he can help us like he did yesterday. ‘I think now in the game, if we move a lot, it will be difficult for defenders to pick up one player, to stay with them. The manager led us to be free on the pitch, so we understand each other well. So this just helps us and hopefully it can happen many more times this season.’ The striker was quick to point out the victory was down to the whole team’s display, though, not just that of the front three. Furthermore, he believes it was a performance and result which laid down a marker for the season to come. ‘I think the whole group was very good, we tried to do our job,’ he continued. ‘We conceded two goals, but I think we did a great game. It's very difficult to play there and get the three points, and that is the important thing. ‘I think it's too early to say what our target is, but we need to go step-by-step. We have to focus on the Premier League and the cups. We have a lot of time to train as well, to know what the coach wants from us. Let's see in the end, hopefully we can achieve our targets. ‘I will enjoy this season, of course, because I think we can achieve higher things. When you play for Chelsea, you always need to look for that. Yesterday was a great game to show our power and hopefully we can continue like this in the rest of the season.’ Up next is our midweek Carabao Cup clash against Luton Town and Alonso's Premier League home debut against Brighton & Hove Albion. news.body_zh: 若昂·佩德罗相信切尔西在一场令人印象深刻的首场比赛中展示了我们的实力，这对蓝军来说可能是一个伟大的赛季，特别是巴西人与科尔·帕尔默和摩根·罗杰斯一起以全新的进攻方式排列。哈维·阿隆索作为切尔西主教练的第一场正式比赛的首发阵容中，若昂·佩德罗为中锋，两侧由帕尔默和夏季签约的罗杰斯支持。事实证明，它的首场比赛就取得了巨大成功，周一晚上，我们以 3-2 的英超联赛客场战胜邻居富勒姆，开始了 2026/27 年赛季，这三名球员都取得了进球。自从在克雷文小屋首次亮相后，这三名前锋就已经在蓝军球迷中引起了极大的兴奋，在充满运动和巧妙组合的表演后，若昂·佩德罗似乎也分享了这一点。 “科尔和摩根，他们是特别的球员。每个人都知道这一点，”若昂·佩德罗在切尔西取得赛季开局后说道。 “我非常感激能和他们一起比赛，因为我知道如果我像昨天一样跑动，你知道科尔和摩根会把球交给我，我必须准备好得分。所以和他们一起玩对我来说很特别。 “我只是努力享受每场比赛并努力帮助我的球队。那么这个赛季，看看我能得到什么。我只是尝试抓住每一个机会得分。 “我很久以前就认识摩根了，因为我们互相交手，”我们的新九号补充道。 “所以当他加入俱乐部时，我知道这对我们非常有好处，因为他是一名非常优秀的球员，我认为他可以像昨天一样帮助我们。 “我认为现在在比赛中，如果我们移动太多，后卫将很难抓住一名球员并与他们呆在一起。主教练带领我们在球场上自由自在，所以我们彼此很了解。所以这对我们很有帮助，希望这个赛季能发生更多次。”这位前锋很快指出，胜利取决于整个球队的表现，而不仅仅是前三名的表现。此外，他相信这是为即将到来的赛季奠定了基础的表现和结果。 “我认为整个团队都非常好，我们尽力做好我们的工作，”他继续说道。 “我们丢了两个球，但我认为我们踢了一场精彩的比赛。在那里打球并拿到三分是非常困难的，这才是重要的事情。 “我认为现在说我们的目标还为时过早，但我们需要一步一步来。我们必须专注于英超联赛和杯赛。我们也有很多时间训练，了解教练对我们的要求。让我们看看最后，希望我们能够实现我们的目标。 “当然，我会享受这个赛季，因为我认为我们可以取得更高的成就。当你为切尔西效力时，你总是需要寻找这一点。昨天是一场精彩的比赛，展示了我们的力量，希望我们能在本赛季余下的比赛中继续这样。接下来是我们周中对阵卢顿镇的卡拉宝杯比赛，以及阿隆索对阵布莱顿的英超主场首秀。立即获得 VIP 体验，与切尔西俱乐部度过难忘的斯坦福桥比赛日！

news.title: Chelsea Women vs Real Sociedad Women: How to watch, kick-off time, live stream info
news.title_zh: 切尔西女足 vs 皇家社会女足：如何观看、开球时间、直播信息
news.body_en: Chelsea Women play at the Cherry Red Records Stadium for the first time on Wednesday evening as we embark on our UEFA Women's Champions League campaign for the 2026/27 season. The Blues will play home domestic cup and any home European qualifying or league phase matches at the Cherry Red Records Stadium, while all Women’s Super League home matches will be at Stamford Bridge from the start of the campaign. Our third-place finish in the Women's Super League this season means we will play the qualifier against Real Sociedad to determine whether or not we enter the league phase of the Women's Champions League competition for 2026/27. The match will be played over two legs, with the second fixture at the Estadio Zubieta in San Sebastian scheduled for 2 September at 6pm. Here is everything you need to know about how to watch Chelsea Women against Real Sociedad, including kick-off time and how to follow the action on official Chelsea channels. Chelsea Women's game against Real Sociedad takes place on Wednesday 26 August 2026 at the Cherry Red Records Stadium, with kick-off scheduled for 6.45pm UK time. Tickets are still available to purchase for Wednesday's match, but if you can't make it to the Cherry Red Records Stadium, then you can still watch our UWCL qualifier against Real Sociedad Women for free on the Chelsea website and Chelsea Official App. As always, team news, live updates and match coverage will be provided in our Chelsea Women vs Real Sociedad Women Match Centre on the Chelsea Official App and Chelsea website. You can also follow through Chelsea Women’s social media channels on X, Facebook, Instagram and TikTok. Chelsea won both of our pre-season friendlies, firstly with a 7-0 success against Auckland FC in New Zealand, followed up by a 3-0 victory over an A-League All-Stars side in Sydney. Meanwhile, Real Sociedad finished third in Liga F this season but in pre-season drew 1-1 with Logrono United and lost 2-0 to Portuguese side SCU Torreense. This is the first match in our history against Real Sociedad. Last season, we only faced Spanish opposition once, when Ellie Carpenter's stunning strike earned us a 1-1 draw against Barcelona in the UWCL league phase at Stamford Bridge. Be there to welcome CFCW to our new home at Stamford Bridge when we take on Aston Villa in our first Women's Super League match of the season on 5 September at 12.35pm!

news.title: Alonso explains how Palmer, Joao Pedro and Rogers can lead and inspire
news.title_zh: 阿隆索解释帕尔默、若昂·佩德罗和罗杰斯如何领导和激励
news.body_en: Fulham discovered exactly what the attacking trio Cole Palmer, Joao Pedro and Morgan Rogers of are capable of at Craven Cottage on Monday evening. It was far less of a surprise for Blues manager Xabi Alonso, who believes the trio can inspire their Chelsea team-mates throughout the campaign. Palmer’s qualities are well known to Chelsea supporters; the 24-year-old has showcased them throughout his time at Stamford Bridge. Joao Pedro, who scored 20 goals and was named Player of the Season, has also demonstrated his talents on countless occasions. Rogers’ addition came earlier this summer and he has needed little time to adapt to life at Chelsea. Alonso deployed the three from the start against Fulham. Within 31 seconds, Palmer had teed up Joao Pedro to open the scoring. Rogers then opened his account in blue – sweeping home after good work from fellow signing Maxence Lacroix – and Joao Pedro returned the favour in the second period for Palmer, who netted his first of the campaign from an acute angle. Their goals proved decisive, with the Blues coming away from our west London neighbours with a 3-2 victory. And Alonso, while insisting he would not construct a team around the trio, emphasised what Palmer, Joao Pedro and Rogers can bring to the Chelsea side. He said: ‘They are going to be a very important part, but to build around them, no, it’s to build a team with them. They need to take responsibility, they need to lead the rest, they need to inspire the rest, because if they do great, the others will follow. 'We need to use them in the best possible situations and we need to have good links to reach them and they need to help the team be solid. The three of them, they have played for the team and scored, and that’s always important for the forwards.’ Palmer’s display on the banks of the Thames was particularly encouraging. For much of the previous campaign, he struggled with injury. It inhibited his game, with the England international admitting he wasn’t sure from one day to the next whether he would be in discomfort. Yet against Fulham, having had the summer off, Palmer appeared back to his fluid best. He weaved effortlessly beyond challenges and, while scoring and fashioning chances for team-mates, was also hugely impressive without the ball. Naturally, Alonso was pleased for the Blues’ No.10, and highlighted the influence Palmer can have when enjoying his football. He said: ‘I am very happy for Cole because I have really enjoyed seeing him play with this dynamism, with this freedom, with this responsibility, helping the team, and feeling important. We need that for the team. If Cole feels this way, we will have a better team and a better Chelsea. 'I am happy for him that he enjoyed his game, and you can see that.’ Up next is our midweek Carabao Cup clash against Luton Town and Alonso's Premier League home debut against Brighton & Hove Albion. news.body_zh: 周一晚上，富勒姆在克雷文小屋准确地发现了进攻三人组科尔·帕尔默、若奥·佩德罗和摩根·罗杰斯的能力。对于蓝军主教练哈维·阿隆索来说，这并不令人意外，他相信这三人能够在整个赛季激励他们的切尔西队友。帕尔默的品质为切尔西球迷所熟知。这位 24 岁的球员在斯坦福桥效力期间就展现了这些。打进20球并被评为赛季最佳球员的若奥·佩德罗也无数次展现了自己的才华。罗杰斯于今年夏天早些时候加盟，他几乎不需要时间来适应切尔西的生活。阿隆索在对阵富勒姆的比赛中从一开始就部署了三人。 31秒内，帕尔默就与若奥·佩德罗开球，首开纪录。随后，罗杰斯身着蓝色球衣，在队友马克森斯·拉克鲁瓦 (Maxence Lacroix) 的出色表现后，横扫主场，而若奥·佩德罗 (Joao Pedro) 在下半场回报了帕尔默 (Palmer)，帕尔默以敏锐的角度攻入了本赛季的第一个进球。他们的进球起到了决定性的作用，蓝军以 3-2 的比分战胜了我们的西伦敦邻居。阿隆索虽然坚称自己不会围绕这三人组建一支球队，但强调了帕尔默、若昂·佩德罗和罗杰斯可以给切尔西带来什么。他说：“他们将成为非常重要的一部分，但要围绕他们进行建设，不，是与他们一起建立一支团队。”他们需要承担责任，需要领导其他人，需要激励其他人，因为如果他们做得很好，其他人就会效仿。 “我们需要在最好的情况下使用他们，我们需要有良好的联系来联系他们，他们需要帮助球队变得稳固。他们三人为球队效力并进球，这对前锋来说总是很重要。”帕尔默在泰晤士河畔的表现尤其令人鼓舞。在上个赛季的大部分时间里，他都在与伤病作斗争。这抑制了他的比赛，这位英格兰国脚承认他每天都不确定自己是否会感到不适。然而在对阵富勒姆的比赛中，在经历了夏天的休息后，帕尔默似乎又回到了他流畅的最佳状态。他毫不费力地克服了挑战，在为队友得分和创造机会的同时，在无球情况下也给人留下了深刻的印象。自然，阿隆索对蓝军的 10 号球员感到高兴，并强调了帕尔默在享受足球时可以产生的影响力。他说：“我为科尔感到非常高兴，因为我真的很高兴看到他充满活力、自由、责任，帮助球队，并感到自己很重要。我们的团队需要这样的东西。如果科尔有这样的感觉，我们将拥有一支更好的球队和更好的切尔西。 “我为他感到高兴，他喜欢自己的比赛，你可以看到这一点。”接下来是我们周中对阵卢顿镇的卡拉宝杯比赛，以及阿隆索对阵布莱顿的英超主场首秀。立即获得 VIP 体验，与切尔西俱乐部度过难忘的斯坦福桥比赛日！

The Rooted in Rhythm range marks a significant moment of that mission – allowing our strong ethos of inclusion to ripple from the centre of how the club operates, reaching our fanbase, our local communities and beyond. The Carnival Statement Jersey, Carnival Tee-Shirt, Carnival Sweatshirt and Carnival Track Jacket that make up the collection all showcase bold colouring, flowing lines and striking silhouettes travelling across the garments with typography and pattern unfolding from every angle. The Rooted in Rhythm Collection celebrates the rhythm of football and pulse of the neighbourhood as the unique history and colours of west London and carnival unite. news.title: Omari Kellyman joins RC Strasbourg
news.title_zh: 奥马里·凯利曼加盟 RC 斯特拉斯堡
news.body_en: Omari Kellyman has completed a permanent transfer to Ligue 1 club RC Strasbourg. The attacking midfielder joined Chelsea from Aston Villa in the summer of 2024 and made his Premier League 2 debut for the Blues in August that year before injury curtailed his maiden season at Stamford Bridge. Kellyman enjoyed a successful loan spell at Cardiff City last campaign, helping the Bluebirds achieve promotion to the Championship. He then featured twice during Chelsea's tour of Australia and Asia this pre-season. We wish Omari every success as he begins a new chapter in his career.
news.body_zh: 奥马里·凯利曼已完成永久转会至法甲俱乐部 RC 斯特拉斯堡。这位攻击型中场球员于 2024 年夏天从阿斯顿维拉加盟切尔西，并于当年 8 月首次代表蓝军参加英超二级联赛，随后因伤缩短了他在斯坦福桥的处子赛季。凯利曼上赛季租借到卡迪夫城取得了成功，帮助蓝鸟队晋级英冠。随后，他在切尔西季前赛的澳大利亚和亚洲之旅中两次出场。我们祝愿奥马里在开启职业生涯新篇章时取得成功。

news.title: Berkeley-Agyepong joins Reading
news.title_zh: 伯克利-阿吉彭加盟雷丁
news.body_en: Jeremiah Berkeley-Agyepong has joined Reading on a permanent basis. The teenager has been with Chelsea since Under-8 level, developing through the ranks, and was part our Under-15 side that won the Premier League Floodlit Cup. The winger featured for the Under-18 side during pre-season of 2024/25, and now moves to Berkshire for the next stage of his career. We wish Jeremiah well for the future.
news.body_zh: 耶利米·伯克利-阿吉蓬已永久加入雷丁。这位少年从U-8级别开始就在切尔西效力，在队伍中不断发展，并且是我们赢得英超泛光杯的U-15球队的一员。这位边锋在 2024/25 赛季季前赛期间为 18 岁以下球队效力，现在转会至伯克希尔，开启职业生涯的下一阶段。我们祝愿耶利米未来一切顺利。

news.title: Morgan Rogers: An enjoyable debut!
news.title_zh: 摩根·罗杰斯：令人愉快的首秀！
news.body_en: As debuts go, that Chelsea one from Morgan Rogers wasn’t half bad. After his switch to Stamford Bridge from Aston Villa, the England international would have been itching to hit the ground running. So scoring and helping the Blues to victory over Fulham will certainly have helped. Our No.17 restored our lead at Craven Cottage, after Joshua King had cancelled out Joao Pedro’s opener – which came after just 32 seconds. Cole Palmer, a close friend of Rogers, made it 3-1 just after the break, before Gonzalo Garcia reduced the deficit for Fulham. In the end, the Blues took all three points and Rogers – who played a key role alongside Palmer in a number ten role for Xabi Alonso’s side – believes this victory was a good start, but just that: a start. He believes there are still many gears for us to go up. ‘It was a great game to play in,’ Rogers said with a beaming smile. ‘Obviously to score and help the team win, that’s everything that I wanted from a debut. ‘I thought the quality of our play was excellent and it was so enjoyable out there. Fulham is a difficult place to come to, and they played really well, but we had that fight, that grit and I think we were the better team on the night. ‘For me, we deserved the win and I’m really happy with how the game went.’ Rogers would have been keen to make an impression at his new club, following his summer switch from Aston Villa, and having arrived later than some of his team-mates due to his involvement at the World Cup, the attacker believes the best version of him is still to come. ‘I didn’t feel that sharp towards the end, I was a bit tired and that’s why I came off for the last 10 minutes,’ admitted Morgan. ‘I’ve felt really good in pre-season but I’ve not had much of a break due to the World Cup, so I wanted to keep myself fresh. ‘Coming to a new team, you don't want to come in sluggish and off the pace, so I tried to keep myself in the best shape as possible and I’ve tried to get up to speed as quickly as I can. ‘I still think there are more gears to go, and I've got to try and find them as quickly as possible because the games are coming thick and fast. ‘But as I said, I felt good out there and I enjoyed it.’ Up next is our midweek Carabao Cup clash against Luton Town and Xabi Alonso's Premier League home debut against Brighton & Hove Albion. Secure VIP experiences for an unforgettable Stamford Bridge matchday with Club Chelsea now!
news.body_zh: 随着首秀的进行，摩根·罗杰斯在切尔西的那场比赛还不错。从阿斯顿维拉转投斯坦福桥后，这位英格兰国脚一直渴望开始新的征程。因此进球并帮助蓝军战胜富勒姆肯定会有所帮助。在约书亚·金 (Joshua King) 取消了若昂·佩德罗 (Joao Pedro) 的首开纪录后，我们的 17 号队在克雷文小屋 (Craven Cottage) 恢复了领先优势——比赛仅用了 32 秒。罗杰斯的密友科尔·帕尔默在中场休息后将比分改写为3-1，随后贡萨洛·加西亚帮助富勒姆缩小了比分差距。最终，蓝军全取三分，罗杰斯——他与帕尔默一起在哈维·阿隆索的球队中担任十号球员，发挥了关键作用——相信这场胜利是一个良好的开端，但仅此而已：一个开始。他相信我们还有很多进步空间。 “这是一场很棒的比赛，”罗杰斯微笑着说道。 “显然，进球并帮助球队获胜，这就是我在首秀中想要的一切。 “我认为我们的比赛质量非常好，而且非常令人愉快。富勒姆是一个很难来到的地方，他们踢得非常好，但我们有那场战斗，那份勇气，我认为我们是当晚更好的球队。 “对我来说，我们配得上这场胜利，我对比赛的进展感到非常满意。”罗杰斯在夏季从阿斯顿维拉转会到新俱乐部后，他一直渴望给他的新俱乐部留下深刻的印象，并且由于参加世界杯而比他的一些队友晚到，这位攻击手相信他最好的版本还在后面。摩根承认，“到最后我感觉不是那么敏锐，我有点累，这就是我在最后10分钟下场的原因。” “我在季前赛中感觉非常好，但由于世界杯，我没有太多休息时间，所以我想让自己保持新鲜感。 “来到一支新球队，你不想表现得迟缓、跟不上节奏，所以我尽力让自己保持在最佳状态，并尽可能快地跟上节奏。 “我仍然认为还有更多的装备需要使用，我必须尽快找到它们，因为比赛即将到来，节奏很快。 “但正如我所说，我在那里感觉很好，我很享受。”接下来是我们周中对阵卢顿镇的卡拉宝杯比赛，以及哈维·阿隆索对阵布莱顿的英超主场首秀。立即获得 VIP 体验，与切尔西俱乐部度过难忘的斯坦福桥比赛日！

news.title: Alonso: 'A very professional, solid performance with maturity'
news.title_zh: 阿隆索：“非常专业、稳定且成熟的表现”
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso believes his Chelsea side produced a ‘very professional, solid performance with maturity’ to defeat Fulham in our Premier League opener and send the Chelsea supporters home from Craven Cottage with ‘happy faces’. Our first top-flight match of the campaign didn’t disappoint, with the west London derby against our neighbours testing the Blues in a variety of different ways. We broke the deadlock after just 32 seconds when Cole Palmer flicked a pass to Joao Pedro, who produced a deft finish to put us ahead. Fulham hit back midway through the opening period via Josh King, but Alonso’s side went into the interval ahead when Morgan Rogers struck on his debut. Cole Palmer then netted soon after the restart and, despite Fulham pulling a goal back through Gonzalo Garcia, we held on to claim all three points. After our win, Alonso highlighted several areas for improvement for his side. Yet the Chelsea manager was pleased to start his tenure with a win that showcased many different qualities we will need throughout the season ahead. ‘It feels very good, for sure,’ Alonso said in his post-match press conference. ‘We know how tough it is to win any Premier League game, and any away Premier League game. We prepared for an intense game, and I feel it was a very professional, solid performance, showing maturity and managing the difficult moments. ‘We got the lead quite early, had chances to score the second one, but after the equaliser we were through ten minutes when we didn’t choose the right moments to press and the movements. 'We corrected this well and in the second half, we felt comfortable without the ball, controlling the game. It was a performance to build for the future. There are things to improve for sure, but it was a good first day.’ Alonso added: ‘[It’s important] to manage in difficult moments, not to lose this emotional control. We know the Premier League is fantastic because sometimes the games are out of your hands. 'You don’t control them, so the players on the pitch need to know how to manage it – it’s as important as the tactics being right. It’s a process but today we went through good moments on that and we need to carry on that.’ After the full-time whistle was blown at Craven Cottage, Alonso and his players made their way over to the Chelsea faithful who had made the short trip down the Fulham Road to support their side. The Spaniard believes such moments are important in building a connection between those on the pitch and those in the stands. He said: ‘We are happy to play our first Premier League game of the season. My first official Premier League game with Chelsea felt great; in this stadium with our fans at the end, celebrating with them. ‘I had the feeling before kick-off that they were excited and they were hoping to see a good performance from the team, a serious one, and one they could see that we gave everything and fought for everything. I saw happy faces in the end and it’s important to create this bond. It’s early days, first game, but a good one.’
news.body_zh: 哈比·阿隆索相信他的切尔西队在我们的英超揭幕战中打出了“非常专业、可靠且成熟的表现”，击败了富勒姆，并带着“幸福的面孔”送切尔西支持者从克雷文小屋回家。我们本赛季的第一场顶级比赛并没有让人失望，西伦敦德比对阵我们的邻居，以各种不同的方式考验着蓝军。仅仅 32 秒后，科尔·帕尔默 (Cole Palmer) 将球传给若昂·佩德罗 (Joao Pedro)，后者灵巧的射门帮助我们取得领先，我们打破了僵局。富勒姆在开场中段通过约什·金进行反击，但阿隆索的球队在摩根·罗杰斯首次亮相时进入了中场休息。比赛重新开始后不久，科尔·帕尔默就进球了，尽管富勒姆通过冈萨洛·加西亚扳回一球，但我们还是保住了全部三分。在我们获胜后，阿隆索强调了他的球队需要改进的几个领域。然而，切尔西主帅很高兴以一场胜利开始他的任期，这场胜利展示了我们在未来整个赛季中需要的许多不同品质。 “当然，感觉非常好，”阿隆索在赛后新闻发布会上说道。 “我们知道赢得任何一场英超比赛以及任何客场英超比赛是多么困难。我们准备了一场激烈的比赛，我觉得这是一场非常专业、扎实的表现，展现了成熟度并处理了困难时刻。 “我们很早就取得了领先，有机会打进第二球，但在扳平比分后，我们在十分钟内没有选择正确的施压时机和动作。 “我们很好地纠正了这一点，在下半场，我们在无球的情况下感觉很舒服，控制了比赛。这是一场为未来打造的表演。肯定有一些事情需要改进，但这是一个很好的第一天。”阿隆索补充道：“[重要的是]在困难时刻进行管理，而不是失去情绪控制。我们知道英超联赛非常棒，因为有时比赛并不在你的掌控之中。 “你无法控制他们，所以球场上的球员需要知道如何管理——这与正确的战术同样重要。这是一个过程，但今天我们经历了美好的时刻，我们需要继续下去。”在克雷文小屋终场哨声吹响后，阿隆索和他的球员们走向了切尔西球迷，他们沿着富勒姆路进行了短暂的旅行来支持他们的球队。西班牙人相信这样的时刻对于在球场上和看台上建立联系非常重要。他说：“我们很高兴能够参加本赛季的第一场英超比赛。我与切尔西的第一场正式英超比赛感觉很棒；最后在这个体育场与我们的球迷一起庆祝。 “开球前我有一种感觉，他们很兴奋，希望看到球队有出色的表现，认真的表现，他们可以看到我们付出了一切，为一切而奋斗。我最终看到了幸福的面孔，建立这种联系很重要。现在还为时过早，第一场比赛，但是一场精彩的比赛。”

news.title: Match report: Fulham 2-3 Chelsea
news.title_zh: 比赛战报：富勒姆 2-3 切尔西
news.body_en: Joao Pedro, Morgan Rogers and Cole Palmer all got on the scoresheet as Xabi Alonso's first game in charge of Chelsea ended in a 3-2 victory over west London neighbours Fulham at Craven Cottage. We made the ideal start to a half in which momentum swung back and forth. After just 32 seconds, Palmer flicked a pass into the path of Joao Pedro, who broke clear of the Fulham backline to score. Fulham equalised via Josh King in the 23rd minute, but Alonso's side responded and deservedly went into the interval ahead when, after excellent work from Maxence Lacroix, Rogers swept home on his debut. Palmer got his name on the scoresheet early into the second half, finishing off an attack which included contributions from Rogers and Joao Pedro. Yet Fulham hit back quickly through Gonzalo Garcia. The Blues had to dig in during the time that remained. It was about grit and determination – and we came through to ensure a winning start for Alonso and to our Premier League campaign. Marco Palestra and Moises Caicedo both missed the game with minor setbacks. So Alonso opted for a starting XI of Robert Sanchez, Josh Acheampong, Maxence Lacroix, Levi Colwill, Malo Gusto, captain Reece James, Romeo Lavia, Jorrel Hato, Palmer, Rogers and Joao Pedro. Alonso anticipated a fiery west London derby – and the game lived up to his expectations. Yet we made the perfect start at Craven Cottage, with our opening goal arriving inside 35 seconds. There appeared little danger when a Fulham clearance was fired into the Chelsea half, but Lacroix won his header, the ball broke to Palmer, who flicked it deftly into the path of Joao Pedro. The Brazilian's first touch set him free of the Fulham defence and he lifted a fine finish over Leno. The goal was an instant settler and enabled the Blues attackers to begin expressing themselves. Rogers and Palmer linked neatly throughout the opening period and fashioned chances. The former saw a powerful shot blocked from the edge of the area; the latter forced Bernd Leno into a near-post save with a powerful drive. As the half progressed, Fulham started to wrestle momentum their way. King forced Sanchez into a smart reaction stop and, from the resulting corner, Cesar Palacios fired harmlessly over the crossbar. The home side did manage to pull level midway through the opening 45 minutes, as a neat exchange of passes down the Blues' left flank enabled King to break into the penalty area and drill a shot beyond Sanchez. A reaction was needed from Alonso's side. It quickly came. After seeing off a spell of Fulham pressure, we created several opportunities. Joao Pedro had the first, volleying a Palmer cross narrowly wide, before James tested Leno following a blocked Rogers shot. Lavia was next to be thwarted by the Fulham goalkeeper, who reacted well to deny the Belgian midfielder from close range following a well-worked short corner by the Blues. Deservedly, our efforts were eventually rewarded four minutes before the interval. After collecting possession on the half-turn, Palmer slipped a pass to Lacroix, who did excellently to trick his way beyond Jorge Cuenca and cross from the byline. The ball raced across the Fulham penalty area into the path of fellow summer signing Rogers, who swept home a finish to score on his Blues debut. There was time before the interval to push for a third, and the vibrant Palmer came close with a curled attempt from 20 yards that whistled narrowly wide. Yet, importantly, we went in ahead. Alonso will not have wanted his side to let up – the game felt in our hands – and Palmer picked up from where he left off in the opening period. One sublime run, in which he skipped beyond multiple challenges, almost enabled the Blues' No.10 to guide a finish into the far post. But moments later, there was no mistake. Our third goal started with Sanchez, who drove a pass forward toward Rogers. The England international flicked a header onto Joao Pedro, who bound into the Fulham half, waited for an overlap from Palmer and slipped in his fellow attacker. Palmer assessed his options, which were minimal, and opted to guide a shot between the legs of Leno. The Fulham goalkeeper was beaten, and the Blues had a third goal. Yet, as in the first half, Fulham pulled themselves back into the game by quickly reducing the deficit. The Blues didn't deal with a long ball forward and Timothy Castagne collected and fired a shot toward goal. Sanchez saved, but the rebound fell to Garcia, who reacted well to head home. The game became less frenetic as it progressed, with Alonso's side gaining greater control. It meant chances were harder to come by, although Joao Pedro did fire over an attempt from distance. With 25 minutes to play, the Blues manager turned to his bench. Pep Chavarria was introduced for his Blues debut for Hato, while Enzo Fernandez replaced Lavia. As the minutes ticked down, Fulham pushed hard for an equaliser. King came close again with another low effort that this time fizzed beyond the post, before a long ball forward presented Antonee Robinson with an opportunity to lob Sanchez. However, the USA international guided his attempt wide. With eight minutes remaining, Alonso made two more changes. Geovany Quenda and Estevao Willian were brought on; Rogers and Palmer were replaced. Sanchez had to stay alert in the closing stages, and the Blues goalkeeper reacted well to deny substitute Ryan Sessegnon at his near post. Four minutes of additional time were added. Yet just before they were entered, we had the ball in the back of the net. Quenda had a shot saved by Leno and Joao Pedro turned home the rebound, but the Portuguese winger was offside in the build-up. It mattered not, as Alonso's side saw out the contest to ensure we started the season with a victory and three points. It's a quick turnaround for the Blues, as we return to action on Thursday evening in the Carabao Cup, with League One Luton Town visiting Stamford Bridge.
